items.promptText: How much is the sales tax?
What does a year of insurance cost?
What is the total cost of the first year of ownership?
How much more than the sticker price is that?
By what percentage does the first-year total exceed the sticker price? Round to one decimal place.
Assuming insurance and maintenance stay the same and nothing else recurs, what does the second year cost?
Sort the six costs into one-time and recurring, and explain which sort matters more to someone deciding whether they can afford to keep the scooter, as opposed to whether they can afford to buy it.

Verification: $28 a month for twelve months. t2-p1: What is the total cost of the first year of ownership? Answer: $1,961.00. Verification: $1,250 sticker + $75 tax + $85 registration + $120 required gear + $336 insurance + $95 maintenance. t2-p2: How much more than the sticker price is that? Answer: $711.00. Verification: $1,961.00 first-year total less the $1,250 advertised. t2-p3: By what percentage does the first-year total exceed the sticker price? Round to one decimal place. Answer: 56.9%. Verification: $711.00 on a $1,250 base is 0.5688, or 56.9% to one decimal place. t3-p1: Assuming insurance and maintenance stay the same and nothing else recurs, what does the second year cost? Answer: $431.00. Verification: Only insurance ($336) and maintenance ($95) recur; sticker, tax, registration, and gear are one-time.
